instruction: Write a PersistentVolume with 10Gi storage, accessMode ReadWriteOnce, hostPath /data.
output:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: local-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 10Gi
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  storageClassName: local-storage
  hostPath:
    path: /data

instruction: Write a Pod using a PVC at mount path /data.
output:

  name: pod-with-pvc
spec:
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "sleep 3600"]
    volumeMounts:
    - name: data
      mountPath: /data
  volumes:

instruction: Write an emptyDir volume shared between two containers.
output:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: shared-emptydir
spec:
  containers:
  - name: writer
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "echo hello > /shared/file.txt && sleep 60"]
    volumeMounts:
    - name: shared
      mountPath: /shared
  - name: reader
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "cat /shared/file.txt && sleep 60"]
    volumeMounts:
    - name: shared
      mountPath: /shared
  volumes:
  - name: shared
    emptyDir: {}

instruction: Write a PV with local storage on node and nodeAffinity.
output:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: local-pv
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 100Gi
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  storageClassName: local-storage
  local:
    path: /mnt/disks/ssd1
  nodeAffinity:
    required:
      nodeSelectorTerms:
      - matchExpressions:
        - key: kubernetes.io/hostname
          operator: In
          values:
          - node-1

instruction: Write a Deployment with an initContainer that copies content from an emptyDir to the app volume.
output:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: init-copy
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: init-copy
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: init-copy
    spec:
      initContainers:
      - name: init
        image: busybox:1.36
        command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "cp /app-src/* /app-dest/"]
        volumeMounts:
        - name: app-src
          mountPath: /app-src
        - name: app-dest
          mountPath: /app-dest
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: app:latest
        volumeMounts:
        - name: app-dest
          mountPath: /app
      volumes:
      - name: app-src
        configMap:
          name: app-files
      - name: app-dest
        emptyDir: {}
